title: drupilot viability assessment cache (assess.json)
description: The machine-readable result of a viability assessment, in the subject's hidden state dir (project_state_dir, under drupilot's data dir; never in the project tree). From 1.0, scripts/analysis/assess.sh writes it (schema 1, ADR 0025): the verdict and the three rubric counts computed from findings.json, the rule that matched, and everything viability-report.md shows; the same tree and lock give the same document outside meta (its time is meta.generated_at). A 0.9 file has no schema key: the model wrote it at the end of /drupilot-assess without fixing every key name or nesting, so its readers (common.sh state_snapshot_json, next-step.sh, port-report.sh) take .verdict (else .effort), .timestamp (else .generated_at, else .meta.generated_at) and .recommended_core_version_requirement, each optional. Hence only verdict is required and the nested shapes below are described leniently.

schema.description: 1 for a file assess.sh wrote; absent in a 0.9 file.

provisional.description: True when Rector or PHPStan gave no verdict (tools): the counts are incomplete and the assessed stage was not recorded.

tools.description: Each extractor's verdict, from findings.json (ok | partial | failed | missing).

subject_digest.description: The subject's digest the assessment was computed on (digest_algo).

meta.description: What changes between two runs (DET-2): generated_at and the drupilot version.

verdict.description: The S/M/L/XL effort verdict of the deterministic rubric (the same closed set state.sh record --effort enforces).

effort.description: The same verdict under the older name readers fall back to.

generated_at.description: Alternative name of timestamp (readers try timestamp first).

subject.description: The subject's path relative to the Drupal root (findings.json subject.path), null when unknown.

contrib.description: Whether the subject is a drupal.org contrib project.

sandbox_core.description: The Drupal core version the analysis ran against.

viability_threshold.description: The resolved DRUPILOT_VIABILITY_THRESHOLD: as a verdict letter (S, M, L, XL) in a schema-1 file, as the setting's word (small, medium, large, xl) in a 0.9 one.

above_threshold.description: True when the verdict strictly exceeds the threshold.

recommended_core_version_requirement.description: From core-strategy.sh --json; port-report.sh falls back to it when the manifest has no core_version_requirement. Null when core-strategy.sh gave no answer.

version_bump.description: The SemVer bump the core target implies (core-strategy.sh); null when it gave no answer.

core_target.description: The core compatibility decision, copied (possibly in part) from scripts/analysis/core-strategy.sh --json.

auto_fixable.description: The auto-fixable vs manual split ("a rough percentage"); the 0.9 flow records an object of counts and percentages (official Rector vs digests broken out).

rector_official_rules.description: {short Rector rule name: number of files it changes} (schema 1: the official and compat passes); {Rule: hits} in a 0.9 file.

digests.description: The digests layer's share, or "off" when it did not run.

hard_breaks.description: The hard breaks found (Twig 3, CKEditor 5, jQuery UI, Symfony 7, ...).

hard_break_categories.description: The findings of each of the four fixed hard-break greps.

manual_items.description: The manual Phase 1 changes the rubric counts.

occurrences.description: The PHPStan occurrences the finding stands for (1 for a catalog finding); manual is their sum.

source.description: The tool and finding that reported it.

pre_existing_d10.description: Whether it already breaks on Drupal 10.

rubric.description: The three rubric counts and the rule that produced the verdict.

deprecations_hard.description: Hard deprecations: the PHPStan occurrences of findings.json findings of class hard (classify-deprecations.sh counts.hard in a 0.9 file).

deprecations_soft.description: Soft deprecations, counted the same way (counts.soft).

deprecations_unknown.description: Unclassified deprecations, counted the same way (counts.unknown).

soft_deprecations_policy.description: The DRUPILOT_SOFT_DEPRECATIONS policy applied (report, defer, fix).

soft_deprecations.description: The soft deprecations, one per symbol (values n/a, or null, when the catalog has none).

phpcs.description: PHPCS summary and the ruleset used (run-phpcs.sh --json).

upgrade_status.description: Upgrade Status result, or why it was skipped.

ready.description: The ready flags at assessment time.

reports.description: Paths of the human artifacts (viability-report.md, port-plan.md).
